Enter the translation URL and model.
Invalid URL or model. Use HTTPS, or explicitly allow HTTP for a supported loopback address. The URL must not contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.

Alibaba Cloud recognizes speech; ChatMock receives only the recognized text for translation. Enabling this uses qwen3-asr-flash-realtime, which must be available in your Alibaba account. Speech and text translation use separate keys.

Run ChatMock on your own computer or server. Enter its /v1 base URL or full /v1/chat/completions URL. Find a model ID in /v1/models. The endpoint must accept model, messages and stream: false, and return choices[0].message.content.

127.0.0.1 on a phone means the phone itself. Use a reachable HTTPS URL for a computer or server. Local HTTP is unencrypted and requires permission; only localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1] and the emulator host 10.0.2.2 are supported. Developers can use adb reverse to forward a computer port to the phone. Leave the key empty unless your proxy requires Bearer authentication. A changed URL does not reuse the saved key.

Recommended ChatMock startup options: --reasoning-compat legacy --reasoning-summary none. The test sends a fixed example and shows elapsed time; it does not send system audio or save your draft. Only Save and use commits the configuration. Keys stay in encrypted storage on this device.
